name: Sweet Lake Biscuits & Limeade "The Basic B" Egg, Cheddar & Bacon Biscuit (Skip the Limeade!)
brandOrRestaurant: Sweet Lake Biscuits & Limeade (Salt Lake City / Riverton / Draper Area, UT)
whyItWorks: "The Basic B" layers fluffy scrambled eggs, melted cheddar & Swiss cheese, and bacon on a tender scratch-made buttermilk biscuit—a solid savory brunch as long as you do NOT order their signature fresh-squeezed limeade.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Basic B" Biscuit Sandwich (egg, cheddar, Swiss, bacon) or plain Biscuit & Honey Butter with scrambled eggs—drink water or herbal tea and strictly avoid all Mint/Raspberry/Classic Limeades (citrus trigger).
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING: Never order Sweet Lake's signature fresh-squeezed Limeades (pure lime juice trigger); also skip "The Hoss" fried chicken sausage gravy biscuit during flares
